rationale: Record a documentation-only change that crosses the design-source-ingest family through its .agents/skills/import-design/** and docs/guides/importing-designs.md selectors. The realtime scripted-UI performance rules previously repeated in the import-design skill and importing-designs guide are consolidated into the view-bridge skill, with the import-design surfaces now pointing there; the trace-analysis and trace-sql skills gain a UI-jank Perfetto playbook and reference SQL.
